_comment: The seven shapes a field report can take. This file is the contract
between the console and the companion app, and it is the only place
either of them learns what a template's fields are called.
The app cannot fetch it. A handset is off-network until the moment it
uploads, and by then the report is already written — so the app ships a
copy compiled in, and the Android build copies this exact file into its
assets rather than keeping a second hand-maintained version that drifts.
`version` is what lets the two ends notice they disagree. It goes up on
any change to a field key, a template key, or an entity mapping; the
submission carries the version it was written against, GET
/api/intake/hello returns the console's, and a mismatch is reported to
the analyst as a warning rather than an error. Renaming or dropping a
field key is what a version bump is FOR: old reports keep the keys they
were written with, and the console renders an unknown key under its raw
name rather than dropping it. Nothing here may ever cause a submission
to be refused.
A template needs either a field marked `required`, or a `require_any`
list saying which fields would between them identify the thing. A vehicle
has no one such field -- sometimes all you get is a plate, sometimes only
a colour and a shape -- but a report with none of them is not about a
vehicle at all.
`entity.name` may be a list of patterns. The first that fills to
something non-empty wins, so a sighting with only a plate still makes a
record rather than none.
Labels and wording are read by a person standing outside in the weather.
Short beats precise.

templates.label: Signal
templates.blurb: Something you heard on the air.
templates.title: {frequency} · {station_id}

fields.label: Who
fields.hint: callsign, unit, name — or what they called themselves

fields.label: Verbatim
fields.hint: tick if the next box is word for word

fields.label: What was said
fields.hint: word for word where you can, the gist where you can't

fields.label: Name or what they were called
fields.hint: "the tall one in the grey coat" is a name too

fields.label: Also known as
fields.hint: one per line

fields.label: What they look like
fields.hint: height, build, hair, marks, what they were wearing

fields.label: Plate
fields.hint: as written, spaces and all

fields.label: Issued by
fields.hint: state or country

fields.label: Make
fields.hint: Ford, Toyota…

fields.label: Who was in it
fields.hint: how many, and anything about them

fields.label: Heading
fields.hint: which way it went

fields.label: Anything else
fields.hint: damage, markings, roof rack, ladder, aerials

templates.label: Activity
templates.blurb: Something happening. Size, activity, location, unit, time, equipment.
templates.title: {activity}

fields.label: Size
fields.hint: how many people, vehicles, whatever it is

fields.label: Activity
fields.hint: what they are doing

fields.label: Location
fields.hint: in words — the position is already attached

fields.label: Unit or group
fields.hint: who they are, or what they are wearing that says so

fields.label: Equipment
fields.hint: vehicles, weapons, radios, tools

templates.label: Bearing
templates.blurb: A direction-finding cut. Two or three of these cross-fix a transmitter.
templates.title: {frequency} bearing {bearing_deg}°

fields.label: Antenna
fields.hint: 3-el yagi, body fade, loop…

templates.label: Place
templates.blurb: What is normally here, and what is here now.
templates.title: {place_name}

fields.label: What is it
fields.hint: the depot, the north gate, 4th and Main

fields.label: Normally
fields.hint: what you would expect to find here

fields.label: This time
fields.hint: what was actually here

fields.label: Getting in and out
fields.hint: gates, cameras, who is watching

templates.label: Note
templates.blurb: No form. Talk, type, or both.
templates.title: {summary}

fields.label: One line
fields.hint: enough to find it again
